text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"NiFeCo_OER_screen_batch12_crystallinity_followup","campaign_class":"routine_oer_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"confirm current plate before deposition"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"change_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-2291","substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard FTO substrate for OER screen"},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"FTO-2291"},"comment":"init per SOP"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"Ni50Fe30Co20 baseline, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":575,"duration":120,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"crystallization anneal, matches batch11 recipe"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"x":12.5,"y":8.0},"comment":"locate deposited spot"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at 10 mA/cm2, standard rate"},{"server":"ml_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"source":"batch12_cp"},"comment":"feed results to surrogate"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":24},"comment":"short stability check"}]}
